audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the final two Science House records: Maru’s complete MarILDA activation and every branch of Robin’s deluxe-bed presentation. Every line, system message, embedded question, response choice, robot voice, scientific term, woodworking detail, gender selector, and family dynamic was reviewed in full event context with canonical Maru, Demetrius, Robin, Yoba and Hardwood terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship and quest conditions, response IDs, placeholders, robot name, branch delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Together with the preceding batch, all Science House records are covered. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
